name: pesopath
description: PesoPath – budget tracker, debt-freedom planner & installment tracker with guided first-time setup (vanilla HTML/CSS/JS)

scripts.test: node tests/debt.test.js && node tests/installments.test.js && node tests/ios-charts.test.js && node tests/service-worker.test.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run web:copy && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.ios:sync: npm run web:copy && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && cap open ios
